thread:
maya: FYI we just got a formal request from AcmeCorp — they want a customer-specific variant: instruct-style tuning on top of base-1.3b, long-context up to 1M tokens, and aggressive quantization (int4 if possible).
aj: Oof, 1M tokens + int4 + instruct. Do we have precedents for that combo?
maya: No exact precedent. We've done long-context builds (up to 256k) and int4 quant on smaller models separately. This is a compound ask: quality + extreme context + small footprint.
samuel: Can we break into phases? intake -> prioritization -> bring-up. Need to capture SLA, data residency, eval hooks, and acceptance criteria.
leah: Agreed. Quick intake answers from the thread: Is this for Hosted or Dedicated or Private? Also is there a hard p50/p95 SLA?
maya: Acme replied: Dedicated or Private (they want VPC for IP). SLA target: p50 < 300ms for short prompts, p95 < 2s. They value deterministic behavior for legal docs. ARR signal: likely 6-9 month enterprise pilot.
aj: Ok priority medium-high. Commercial value + security. But technically hard. We need checklist and a risk matrix.
samuel: Draft checklist (we should iterate):
```
- Intake: owner, customer tier, deployment mode, dataset for instruct tuning, privacy/KMS needs, max context length, latency targets, budget/cost ceiling
- Pre-reqs: verify model lic, base model compatibility with 1M context (sparse attention or chunking?), quantization profile available for target arch
- Experiments: baseline eval on base-1.3b (float16), instruct-tune quick pass, then quantization sweep (int8->int4), long-context stress tests (memory/kv checkpoints)
- Quality gates: pass NLU/e2e evals (precision on legal QA >= 0.82), hallucination rate < X on benchmark set, safety filter results
- Performance gates: p50/p95 under dedicated config, token throughput targets, memory footprint within node limits
- Rollout: canary on isolated pool -> A/B against fallback -> full dedicated pool
```
leah: Nice. For quantization sweep we should log per-token logitshift and sample-time perplexity delta. Also include a regression test against their canonical doc set.
maya: CI bot — add an intake ticket template using the checklist above and tag eng-ml + eng-runtime.
ci-bot: created issue ML-INTAKE-214 in backlog with checklist attached. Link: https://redwood.internal/ML-INTAKE-214
aj: For the 1M context question — two approaches: (1) native long-context model (sparse + block attention) or (2) windowed chunking with retrieval + KV stitching. Option (1) is cleaner but model-dependent. Option (2) is engineering-heavy but we can achieve deterministic latency.
samuel: We should benchmark both. Proposed experiment plan:
- Step A: baseline latency + quality with base-1.3b (float16) with chunking + retrieval on 256k and 1M simulated docs.
- Step B: measure instruct-tune delta on a 2k prompt eval set derived from Acme docs.
- Step C: run quant sweep: int8, int4 (GPTQ-like), per-layer quant probes; measure quality regressions and memory.
- Step D: run perf harness under Dedicated config (g4/rtx or A10) and measure p50/p95.

leah: Experimental acceptance: if int4 causes >6% drop in legal QA F1 vs float16, classify as "not acceptable". Also define fallback: int8 or mixed-int4 for non-critical layers.
maya: Action items: Aj -> prototype chunking test (due 3 days). Samuel -> set up quant sweep infra + baseline eval harness (due 7 days). Leah -> coordinate with AE to get canonical evaluation set and security requirements (due 2 days). I'll own rollout plan and pricing estimate.
aj: Quick note: pricing will need to account for large KV storage and extra reserved capacity. Expect a 2-4x infra multiplier vs standard 1.3b.
samuel: One technical nit: int4 kernels on our runtime currently have known correctness issues with rotary embeddings at extreme seq lengths — add test case.
leah: Add that to checklist: "rotary/rope correctness test at >256k".
ci-bot: scheduled job quant-sweep-ML-214 to run nightly for 14 days.
maya: If we can't meet latency on Dedicated we should propose layered offering: Dedicated w/ longer SLOs + Private on-prem for worst-case deterministic runs.
aj: I'll ping infra for a spare rack to run prototype if needed.
samuel: For eval metrics please track: legal-F1, hallucination-rate, perplexity-delta, p50/p95 latency, memory-usage, qps. Keep results in ML-INTAKE-214 and mark PASSED/FAILED per gate.
maya: Great. I'll summarize for AE and send to Acme with proposed phases. Anything else?
leah: Capture mitigation plan for quant regression: (a) mixed precision, (b) selective layer float, (c) extra calibration data.
aj: Also note: telemetry hooks + audit logs required for Private.
maya: Thanks team. Closing for now — we'll update ML-INTAKE-214 as we hit milestones. :thumbsup:
